title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a name two or more enabled packages hold only as stored rows, and no package ships, is refused by the read naming no package instead of served by save order (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DN286opJo9xyaJevg5Unj4B)_

Fixes #32607

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill and no doc teaches what the read naming no package answers for a name only stored rows of several packages hold (`skills/**` and `content/docs/**` grepped: the `ambiguous-in-environment` mentions are about flow, queue and permission-set references, not `/meta` reads); the refusal's own sentence names the `?package=` remedy.

> **BREAKING** (ADR-0087 `registered`, semantic entry `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`): the read naming no package of a name two or more enabled packages hold only as stored rows, and that no package ships in code, answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming each holder, where it served the row saved first. First-party count: 0. Remedy: name the package (`?package=`), which serves that package's row.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个都启用的包各自存了一行同名元数据、而没有任何包在代码里自带这个名字时，不带包名的读取（裸读 `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME`、`/published`、执行读）现在答 409 并点名这两个包；以前它按保存顺序返回先存的那一行。`/layers` 本来就答 409，保持原样不动。
- 为什么改：同一个名字，裸读答“先保存的那一行”、`/layers` 却答 409，答案取决于保存顺序，等于替调用方猜了一个包，违反史诗红线 2（歧义要报告，不许猜）。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（narrowing，BREAKING，metadata-protocol minor），第一方 0 处。只有一个包存了行、有包在代码里自带该名字、带 `?package=` 的精确读、被拒的行（declined）、某包的定制配对行、依赖包给行持有的基础包追加的语言成员，答案都不变。第 2 轮按复审修了 5 处（见 Round 2）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `storedRowHoldersRefusal`（只按行的粒度判持有者）与 `readMetaItemFace`（把读到的行交给 `readMetaItem`）；`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` 与 `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 各一个 catch 块（让 `/layers` 继续答写入口的 409）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` 的 `[#32607]` 组。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts -t 32607`，预期全部通过：两种注册顺序 × 两种保存顺序下裸读都是 409 点名两个包，单持有者 CONTROL 仍答 200。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`servedRowHolderOf` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, the row-aware served-holder judgment #32354 landed in #33130) answered only when some package was disabled. With no disabled package it returned `undefined`, so the plain read fell through to `findServedOverlayRow`, which takes the first row by save order, while `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` counted both bindings and refused 409. Same name, two doors, two answers, and one of them a guess.

Now the item face (`readMetaItemFace`, which the plain read, `/published` and the execution face share) asks the judgment with `{ refuseWithoutDisabled: true }`:

- With no disabled holder, and only for a name no enabled package ships at any member (`shippedArtifactsOf(type, name)`, the set `packagelessContentPackage` already counts), `storedRowHoldersRefusal` judges the holders at ONE grain: the packages the item's active rows are bound to at the member, as the read binds them (`packagelessAddress`), less rows the reads decline and rows of a customization pair of another package the rows or the registry name. It never unites them with the registry's holders of the name (one bare slot, the row written or hydrated last). Two or more are refused with the by-name read's own refusal (`ambiguous-in-environment`, `details.candidates`); one or none: `undefined`, the read as it was.
- The rows that judgment reads are read on the face's cache key and handed to `readMetaItem` (`PrereadActiveRows`), which takes them for the same item: the item face reads the item's active rows once (#24371).
- A shipped name never fell to save order: the read's own content judgment counts the shipper. So a bundled type's base shipping one member beside another package's row of another member (an email template's `en-US` shipped, a dependent's `fr-FR` row) keeps its answer. The first dogfood run on `3b9a447dc3` caught exactly that over-reach (three #28802 pins, `expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 404 }`); `abd91aad9e` adds the guard.
- Every other caller of the judgment (the layered read's re-addressing and `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`) passes no option and is unchanged, so `/layers` keeps the package-less writes' refusal (#28337, ruling Q1 = A, 6820653691).
- A1 (6821134180) and its runtime twin (6836791341): each transport's layered chain reads the plain read first to find a disabled owner (step 1b). That read now refuses, so step 1b catches the refusal and, when it is this judgment's own refusal (marked under the registered symbol `objectstack.metadata-protocol.storedRowHoldersRefusal`) and step 1c (`packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`) has a refusal for the address, hands over to it; every other error is rethrown as before.

| Door, naming no package (E, F enabled, each storing a row of `d1`; no package ships `d1`) | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/:type/:name` | 200, the row saved first | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates` = E, F |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/published` | 200, a row (`RestServer`: the row saved first; runtime dispatcher: the same package in every save order) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming E, F |
| execution face (`getMetaItemForExecution`) | the row saved first | the same refusal |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` | 409, the package-less writes' refusal | unchanged |
| `?package=E` / `?package=F` | that package's row | unchanged |
| one package storing a row (CONTROL) | 200, that row | unchanged |
| a name an enabled package ships at any member (e.g. base ships `en-US`, a dependent stores `fr-FR`), package-less `fr-FR` read | 404 / the pair's row | unchanged |
| a package's row beside its customization pair's undeclared row (M1) | that read's own pick | unchanged: no door refuses or names the pair |
| `email_template`: base stores `en-US` (nobody ships it), a dependent stores `fr-FR` (M2): plain read, `/layers`, execution face at `fr-FR` | the dependent's row | unchanged |
| `/layers` of a name two packages ship in code, each with its own stored row (S1) | the plain read's refusal | unchanged |

Both transports (`RestServer`, the runtime `HttpDispatcher`), both registration orders, both save orders, and on the runtime dispatcher before and after a reboot.

Files: `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` and `protocol.ts` (the hand-over of the rows read once), the A1 hunks in `rest-server.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`, the pins in `rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, the semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts`, and two changesets (`metadata-protocol` minor + `rest`, `runtime` patch, BREAKING, `adr-0087: registered`; `spec` patch for the entry).

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`, describe `[#32607] RestServer: two enabled row holders and no shipper`: NARROWING over 2 registration orders × 2 save orders (plain read 409 with `details.candidates`, `/layers` and `/published` 409 naming both and serving no row, execution face rejects `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`/409, each `?package=` serves its own row); A1 (`/layers` of two enabled row holders leads with the writes' sentence); A1 CONTROLs (two code holders, and two served row holders beside a disabled one, keep the plain read's refusal on `/layers`); CONTROL (one row holder served on every bare door).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, describe `[#32607] two enabled row holders and no shipper`: the same NARROWING on a booted kernel over the runtime dispatcher, 2 registration orders × 2 save orders, before and after a reboot, plus the `/layers` vs `/published` sentence split; CONTROL one row holder, before and after a reboot.
- `runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, describe `[#32607 M1, M2] the no-disabled arm judges holders at the rows' grain`: M1, a package (`com.qa.rowpairbase`) and its pair each storing an undeclared row, both save orders, before and after a reboot: the plain read and `/published` answer 200 and no door refuses or names the pair, each order answering the same before and after the reboot. M2 (n1: a bundled type at a non-canonical member), base storing `en-US`, dependent storing `fr-FR`, both save orders, before and after a reboot: the plain read, `/layers` and the execution face at `fr-FR` serve the dependent's row; the base's `en-US` stays the base's. `/published` takes no member selector (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`), so it is not asked at `fr-FR`.
- REST, `A1 CONTROL (S1)`: two packages ship a name in code, each with its own stored row; `/layers` keeps the plain read's refusal, not the writes' sentence.
- The #28337 pins (`rest/src/meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts` and the runtime twin) are untouched and green.
- The #24371 one-read pins in `objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts` (red on CI at `5d3a6c757c`, Test Core 4/8) are green again.
- The shipped-name guard is pinned by the existing dogfood file `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` (#28802, booted showcase), which this PR leaves untouched.

**Premise re-measured on `main` `89d7bef033`** (this branch's tests, main's three source files): the runtime `[#32607]` NARROWING pins went 4 failed / 2 passed; quoted: `{"success":true,"data":{… "label":"enabled row", "_packageId":"com.qa.row_alpha" …}}: expected [ 200, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]` (E saved first) and `… "label":"third row", "_packageId":"com.qa.row_gamma" …` (F saved first). The bare read still answered by save order.

**Ablation 1** (the item face's `{ refuseWithoutDisabled: true }` replaced by an expression esbuild folds to `false`; `metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found `refuseWithoutDisabled: false }` in 2 built files, and `refuseWithoutDisabled: true }` in 0): runtime 4 failed / 18 passed of 22, REST 6 failed / 33 passed of 39, exactly the NARROWING and A1 pins. Quoted: ``AssertionError: {"type":"dashboard","name":"two_rows_dash","item":{… "label":"healthy row" …}}: expected [ 200, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]``. Restore leg: `ablation-replace --restore` blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean.

**Ablation 3** (the shipped-name guard: `!anyDisabled` replaced by `(globalThis as any).__ABL32607B === 1`; `metadata-protocol` rebuilt; preflight: marker present in 2 built files): the #28802 dogfood file 3 failed / 10 passed of 13, quoted `AssertionError: expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 404 }` (×2) and `expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 200, …(3) }`. Restore leg: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: absent from all 24 built files, tree clean.

**Round 2, measured before the fix** (head `1ab9370442`, the shared-read fix alone): M1 409 naming `com.qa.rowpairbase` and `com.qa.rowpairbase.custom`; M2 409 naming the base and the dependent. **On `main` `89d7bef033`** (main's five source files put back): M2 green, and M1 answers exactly as on this head (no refusal; the row served follows the save order, see Carried).

**Ablation 4** (the one grain: the registry's holders united back into the holders, marker `__ABLU32607` in 2 built files): runtime 3 failed / 22 passed of 25, the M1 and both M2 pins, quoted `RESOURCE_CONFLICT … package "com.qa.rowpairbase"; package "com.qa.rowpairbase.custom"` and `… package "com.qa.mailrowaddon"; package "com.qa.mailrowbase"`. Restored, rebuilt, `--absent` clean. (A first attempt was a no-op: its replacement text contained the anchor and `ablation-replace` refused it; that run is not counted.)

**Ablation 5** (S1: the REST hand-over takes any error, marker condition dropped; src import, no build): 2 failed / 42 passed of 44, the two `A1 CONTROL (S1)` pins, quoted `{"error":"Name the package this layered read is for, …` where the plain read's sentence was expected. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Ablation 2** (REST A1: step 1b's hand-over `return false` replaced by `throw error`; the suite imports `./rest-server.js`, no build): 3 failed / 39 passed of 42: the two `[#32607] … A1` pins and the #28337 pin (`both spellings answer the package-less writes' 409 …`). Restore leg: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- This branch resumes `claude/project-thread-j3i5j5@d721d9a125` and merges `origin/main` once (`89d7bef033`, merge commit `3b9a447dc3`). The merge takes main's landed copies of every file the old branch carried from #32354's `pv4nip` and #32501 (main's #33130 and #33148), drops the patch copy `cb73bf6c`, and replays the card's own seven commits (`ef9fceb2` … `d721d9a1`) onto them. ## Round 2 (review#1 FAIL 6868755969 on `5d3a6c757c`, and CI Test Core 4/8)

- **S2 / CI**: one read of the item's active rows on the item face again (`PrereadActiveRows`); objectql `protocol-meta.test.ts` 94/94.
- **M1, M2**: holders judged at the rows' grain only (`storedRowHoldersRefusal`); pinned as asked, red before the fix, green after; ablation 4.
- **S1**: only the row judgment's own refusal is handed over (registered-symbol marker read by both transports); pinned; ablation 5.
- **n1**: M2 is the first pin on a bundled type at a non-canonical member.
- The changeset's "Not moved" paragraph now states the one grain, the marker, M1 and M2.

## Carried (for the seat to route)

- A package-less row beside two packages' rows of the name: `rows.unbound` leaves the read as it was, so the plain read still takes a row by store order while `/layers` refuses naming both. Not covered by this PR. **Carried by #33210** (p2, triage ruling 6870700526: red line 2 decides, refuse 409 as `/layers` does), together with review#1's n2 of 6870642184 (a row-held base's added member answers the dependent's row where a shipped base answers 404).
- M1's shape (a package's row beside its customization pair's undeclared row, nobody ships the name): no refusal and no pair named any more, but which row the plain read and the execution face serve follows the save order (X then pair saved: X's row; pair then X: the pair's row; `/published` serves X's row in both), measured identically on `main` `89d7bef033`. It is the plain read's own pick between a base row and its pair's undeclared row, not this judgment's. **Folded into #32662** (triage ruling 6870700526).
- #32663 (the registry's one bare slot per stored name) lands after this card; this judgment no longer reads the registry's holders, so it does not move with it.
